# Global Commerce Council

> Documentation for the Global Commerce Council: product catalogue, trade
> knowledge base, HS code directory, country guides and trade tools, in six
> languages. Every document below is plain Markdown — request any URL with
> `Accept: text/markdown` for the source, or read it through the MCP tools
> `list_docs`, `read_doc`, `get_outline` and `search_docs`.

This repository is the documentation. It is served straight from the working
tree by serve-md (see `compose.yaml`), so what a reader sees here is exactly
what is in Git. Links are relative to the file that contains them, and YAML
front matter is metadata for the Hugo build rather than prose for the reader.

## English (en_us)

- [Home](content/en_us/_index.md): Global Commerce Council overview
- [About us](content/en_us/about.md): mission, what we do, values, global reach
- [Products](content/en_us/products/_index.md): the full catalogue, by category
- [Product categories](content/en_us/categories/_index.md): Ceramics, Gypsum, Petroleum, other industries
- [Ceramics](content/en_us/categories/ceramics/_index.md): tiles, sanitary ware, industrial ceramics
- [Gypsum](content/en_us/categories/gypsum/_index.md): standard, fire-resistant and moisture-resistant board
- [Petroleum & petrochemicals](content/en_us/categories/petroleum/_index.md): crude, fuels, naphtha, bitumen, rubber
- [Other industries](content/en_us/categories/other/_index.md): chemicals, industrial salts, sulfur, copper concentrate
- [Knowledge base](content/en_us/knowledge-base/_index.md): trade, logistics, finance, law and marketing topics
- [Polybutadiene rubber guide](content/en_us/knowledge-base/polybutadiene-rubber-guide.md): applications, specifications, standards
- [HS code directory](content/en_us/hscode.md): how goods are classified for customs
- [Country & market guides](content/en_us/country-guides/_index.md): regional export and import playbooks
- [Tools](content/en_us/tools/_index.md): duty calculator, freight calculator, document templates, HS lookup
- [Supply chain network](content/en_us/supply-chain/index.md): raw materials through processing to end markets
- [Supplier directory](content/en_us/suppliers/_index.md): the verified supplier network
- [Contact](content/en_us/contact.md): how to reach the team
- [Terms of service](content/en_us/terms.md)
- [Privacy policy](content/en_us/privacy.md)
